text: Hanan al-Shaykh's The Story of Zahra depicts an Arab Muslim family in Beirut before and during the civil war. Lebanese publishers were unwilling to print it, so al-Shaykh published it herself. When it came out in 1980 it caused such an uproar that it was banned in several Arab countries, with its frankness about sexual and personal issues cited as the reason.
meta_description: The Story of Zahra by Hanan al-Shaykh: self-published in 1980, it was banned in several Arab countries over its treatment of sexual and personal issues.
